tickAlignedCpu.limits: Cumulative CPU counters interpolated at census edges from ~1-second /proc samples. Implied solo throughput assumes unchanged per-tick work/execution cost; not a separate run with remote bots or 2281 sockets.

durationBoundaryCoverage.limits: Percentiles use complete interior 100-tick blocks. The overlapping-block maximum conservatively covers the entire CPU hold plus boundary ticks; equality with interior max determines the whole-hold maximum.

interference.limits: CPU deltas cover processes present at both boundaries; full local-only command-line lists also retained. Short-lived processes require system CPU context.

profile.limits: Current-thread user instructions. Bot one-second reports and simulation 100-tick reports have independent edge intervals. No kernel instruction claim; nested broadcast/admission rows are subsets of simulationTick.

instructionLocations.limits: User retired-instruction event; only USER locations in the measured executable are symbolized, with PT_LOAD virtual offsets. Shared libraries remain module-only because stripped symbols can give misleading nearest-symbol names. Non-user locations remain unattributed, not kernel instruction counts. Inline frames overlap; no dynamic stack. Sample weights are estimates, not exact phase counters. Symbolization follows capture; maps/raw locations remain local-only.
instructionLocations.selection: Top 20 executable self/inline functions per thread; all module/unattributed weights retained. Complete raw location tables remain local-only.

Not calibrated to the current guest, mature A4 world, official delivery or 2281 sockets; not a capacity result or optimization-saving claim.

pristineColdControl.limits: Pristine CLI; 30-second cold warmup then 300-second CPU hold. No length census or duration hooks. Statistics retain complete interior five-second intervals only. Not a mature-length qualification or a matched hook-overhead estimate.
